name: Kick
description: A short front kick with the right leg: the knee lifts, the lower leg snaps out, then the leg returns to the stance. The arms counterbalance and the body leans back slightly on the extension.
poses: wind up: right knee raised toward the chest, body straight, arms ready
extend: right leg snapped forward and level, body leaning back, arms out for balance
recover: right leg lowering, body coming back over the hips
